changes: Added docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md and registered it in docs/requirements/NAV.md. The roadmap turns the three Lattice strengthening themes into 12 executable milestones with source/context mapping, non-goals, gates, tests, evidence, blockers, DONE criteria, sequencing, 3-round 2-host policy, baseline expectations, rollout, risks, and final acceptance template.
usage: Open docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md to plan future strengthening stories. Use docs/requirements/NAV.md to discover the document from the requirements navigation.
expectedOutcome: User sees a new decision document titled "Lattice Strengthening Roadmap Execution Plan" and a NAV entry pointing to decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md. The document clearly says it is an execution plan, not implemented runtime behavior.
actualTranscript: Verified transcript: rg found docs/requirements/NAV.md:31 linking "Lattice Strengthening Roadmap Execution Plan" and docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md:1 with the title. git diff --check passed. lattice scope_contract_check returned pass with 0 unacknowledged violations. lattice validate --story=B-8b07 returned Project validation commands passed and Verification intent coverage: 9/9 covered.
outcomeDiff: No difference: the expected document, NAV registration, explicit plan-only boundary, scope check, and validation coverage are present.
limitations: This story delivered the execution document only. Runtime CLI gates, Authority behavior, baseline runners, and review escalation implementations remain future milestone stories by design.
pitfalls: INIT_CHECK first blocked until scope_freeze_check was recorded. PLAN review then blocked on missing plan.md and missing scope_check; both were fixed through plan_set and an independent scope-plan reviewer.
